articles.title: Enterprise Financial (EFSC) Earnings Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: Enterprise Financial (EFSC) Earnings Transcript. James Lally: Good morning, and thank you all very much for joining us for our 2025 third quarter earnings call. Joining me this morning is Keene Turner, our company's Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer; and Doug Bauche, our company's Chief Banking Officer. As we expected, we saw loan growth return to an annualized level of 6% while deposit growth continued well above this level. Related tickers mentioned: EFSC.

articles.title: AGNC (AGNC) Q1 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: AGNC (AGNC) Q1 2025 Earnings Call Transcript. Peter Federico: Good morning, and thank you all for joining our first quarter conference call. Driven by our attractive monthly dividend, AGNC generated an economic return of 2.4% in the first quarter. The tariff policy announcement at the beginning of April, however, caused volatility to increase significantly across all financial markets. Related tickers mentioned: AGNC.

articles.title: AGNC (AGNC) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: AGNC (AGNC) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript. Peter Federico: Good morning, and thank you all for joining our second quarter earnings call. Following the administration's tariff announcement in early April, elevated governmental policy risk caused investor sentiment to turn sharply negative and financial markets to reassess the macroeconomic and monetary policy outlook. The performance of Agency mortgage-backed securities relative to benchmark interest rates, however, was notably weaker quarter-over-quarter. Related tickers mentioned: AGNC.
